cards.title: Notice Board Narrator Flip
cards.useCase: Adult-led 10-minute paper card for choosing who tells the pocket-park notice board story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place a pencil, eraser, and paper clip beside the card. Adult circles the narrator before writing starts: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick who tells the story, then write what the notice board announces in the tiny park: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Tell it as the stubby pencil who wrote the newest notice: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: Tell it as the silver clip holding the wiggly notice still: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: After two sentences, switch to the other narrator and show what they noticed: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: On the pocket-park board, a note appeared that said ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one sentence where the new narrator spots a detail the first one missed: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to pencil or clip, then draw one tiny notice before writing: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Ask an adult to circle tomorrow's narrator choice on this paper card: ____________________.

cards.title: Spoon Ferry Cargo Swap
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch for a make-believe lunchbox harbor cargo choice: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set out two pencil-case objects and read both cargo choices aloud. Circle one: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write about the spoon ferry carrying one pencil-case cargo across the paper harbor: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The spoon ferry carries eraser crates tied with a ribbon: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The spoon ferry carries paper-clip anchors in a tiny lid box: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Halfway through, swap the cargo and explain what changes on the harbor dock: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: At Lunchbox Harbor, the spoon ferry rang its pencil bell for ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one new sound, shape, or silly dock rule caused by the cargo swap: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the ferry cargo first, then label it with one word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, retell the harbor trip with a new pencil-case cargo: ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Avenue Mood Dial
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper card for changing the feeling of a fictional errand-office scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult reads both mood choices, then lets the child mark one with a pencil dot: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write an Acorn Avenue errand where a pencil-case item changes the office mood: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The errand office feels busy, bright, and full of tapping pencils: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The errand office feels calm, careful, and full of soft eraser pats: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Switch the mood after the acorn clerk opens the drawer, then rewrite the next moment: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: The acorn clerk slid a note across the desk that asked for ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Underline one sentence and change two words so the new mood is clear: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle busy or calm, then copy three mood words onto the card: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Ask an adult to choose a new office mood for a second version: ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Order Toggle
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable card for rearranging a fictional seed-library map-room story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult numbers three paper steps with the child before the story begins: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the seed-library map-room scene in the order chosen on the card: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: First open the pencil case, next unfold the paper map, last choose a seed tag: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: First choose a seed tag, next open the pencil case, last mark the paper map: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Switch the order and explain how the map-room helper reacts to the new first step: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: In the Seed Library Map Room, the ruler shelf pointed toward ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one sentence that uses first, next, or last to make the new order easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number three tiny boxes before writing the full scene: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Bring the card home and ask an adult to renumber the three story steps: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Ending Lever
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper card for choosing a fictional railway ending with pencil-case props: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult reads both endings and places a pencil beside the chosen lever line: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a rain-gauge railway story, then choose the ending switch before the last sentence: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Ending A: the ruler platform measures a perfect pretend raindrop pattern: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: Ending B: the pencil-ticket machine prints a surprise station name: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: Flip the ending switch and write a second last sentence without changing the beginning: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: The Rain Gauge Railway whistle clicked softly beside ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revise the middle by planting one clue that makes the new ending feel earned: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the ending lever and write only the final sentence first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Ask an adult to pick Ending A or Ending B for a family retell: ____________________.
